idea-plugin.name: Rally Integration
idea-plugin.description:
Browse and manage Rally (Broadcom Agile Central) work items without leaving your IDE. A dedicated tool window lists your User Stories, Defects, and Test Cases, shows their details, and lets you create, update, and export them.

Features

  • Ticket list: search by ID or name, filter by scope (All, My Tickets, User Stories, Defects, Test Cases, Recent Activity), state, project, and sprint.
  • Detail panel: HTML description with inline images, plus tabs for linked Test Cases, Tasks, and Attachments. Double-click a test case to see its steps.
  • Create: User Stories and Defects (with project, sprint, severity, priority, and an optional attachment), and Tasks under a story or defect.
  • Update: move tickets to Defined, In-Progress, or Completed (multi-select supported) and edit story points.
  • Start / Finish Working: create and check out a Git branch for the ticket, move it to In-Progress and assign it to you; mark it Completed when done.
  • Export: save tickets and their linked test cases to JSON and Markdown, including attachments and inline images.
  • Sprint summary: ticket counts, story points, planned velocity, and days remaining.
  • Open any ticket in the Rally web UI or copy its ID.

Setup

  1. Open Settings | Tools | Rally.
  2. Enter your Rally server URL (for example, https://rally1.rallydev.com).
  3. Enter your Rally API key (Rally: your profile | API Keys). It is stored in the IDE's password safe.
  4. Enter your workspace and username, then click Test Connection.
  5. Open the Rally tool window.

This is an independent, community-built plugin. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Broadcom Inc. Rally and Agile Central are trademarks of Broadcom Inc.
